name: std-site-header
description: std-site-header — the sticky top bar of a public website: brand (logo + name, linking home when `homeHref` is set), navigation links with the current page marked (a link with children opens a dropdown), an optional light/dark toggle, an optional language picker (std-language-picker: the same page in each language, default language at the root and the others under /<code>/), and an optional call-to-action button. On small screens the links fold into a menu opened by a toggle, with child links indented under their parent and the call-to-action button at the bottom. Links follow `href` (in-app path, #anchor, or absolute URL); the header action and the small-screen menu links also emit NAV_CLICKED { href, label }. Pick for marketing sites, docs portals and product websites; for signed-in app chrome use std-app-layout.
